segments.en: To My beloved son — my dear one — the rabbinical scholar — our Teacher the Rabbi Yitzchok — may his light shine. And with all who have gone forth from his loins — may they live.

segments.he: בָּרוּךְ הַשֵּׁם, יוֹם א' קֹרַח תקצ"ז נֶעמְרוֹב.

segments.he: אֲהוּבִי בְּנִי חֲבִיבִי הָרַבָּנִי מוֹרֵנוּ הָרַב יִצְחָק נֵרוֹ יָאִיר. וְעִם כָּל יוֹצְאֵי חֲלָצָיו שֶׁיִּחְיוּ.

segments.he: מִכְתָּבְךָ קִבַּלְתִּי בְּיוֹם ג' שְׁלַח. וְהָיָה לִי לְנַחַת גָּדוֹל מְאֹד, כִּי עֵינַי הָיוּ צוֹפִיּוֹת וְכָלוֹת כָּל הַזְּמַן לִרְאוֹת מִכְתָּבְךָ, וַיְהִי תּוֹחַלְתִּי נִכְזָבָה, כִּי נִתְעַכֵּב הָאִגֶּרֶת עַד יוֹם ג' הַנַּ"ל. בָּרוּךְ הַשֵּׁם אֲשֶׁר עֲזָרַנִי עַד כֹּה אֲשֶׁר הוֹדַעְתַּנִי שְׁמוּעָה טוֹבָה מִבְּרִיאַת בָּנֶיךָ שֶׁיִּחְיוּ וְשֶׁקִּבַּלְתָּ מִכְתָּבִי וְכוּ'. בָּרוּךְ הַשֵּׁם אֲשֶׁר עֲזָרַנִי עַד כֹּה. וּתְהִלָּה לָאֵל כָּעֵת פֹּה נִשְׁקָט קְצָת, אַךְ עֲדַיִן יֵשׁ לִי בְּכָל עֵת פְּחָדִים כְּשֶׁמִּתְקַבְּצִים אַנְשֵׁי שְׁלוֹמֵנוּ וְאֵינִי יוֹדֵעַ כְּלָל אֵיךְ לְהִתְנַהֵג. וְתוֹדָה לָאֵל בְּשַׁבַּת הֶעָבַר הָיוּ אֶצְלִי אַרְבָּעָה אוֹרְחִים כְּשֵׁרִים, וּבָרוּךְ הַשֵּׁם דִּבַּרְנוּ דִּבְרֵי אֱמֶת וְשָׂמַחְנוּ קְצָת. וְכָל דִּבּוּרֵנוּ הָיוּ מֵעִנְיַן הַמִּדְרָשׁ שֶׁכָּתַבְתִּי לָכֶם אֵין מְחַזְּקִין אֶלָּא לִמְחֻזָּקִין וְכוּ'. וּמֵחֲמַת הַנְּחִיצָה וְגַם אֵינִי יוֹדֵעַ עַל יְדֵי מִי יִהְיֶה נִשְׁלָח לְךָ מִכְתָּבִי כִּי אֲנִי שׁוֹלְחוֹ לִבְרֶסְלֶב, עַל כֵּן אִי אֶפְשָׁר לְהַאֲרִיךְ.

segments.he: דִּבְרֵי אָבִיךָ הַמְצַפֶּה לִישׁוּעָה בְּקָרוֹב לְמַעַן שְׁמוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ.
segments.en: I received your letter on Tuesday, Parshas Sh'lach. And it was a very great comfort to me — for my eyes were watching and yearning all this time to see your letter — and my hope was disappointed — for the letter was delayed until that Tuesday. Blessed be Hashem Who helped me until here — that you informed me of good news from the recovery of your children — may they live — and that you received my letter and so forth. Blessed be Hashem Who helped me until here.
segments.he_nikud: דִּבְרֵי אָבִיךָ הַמְצַפֶּה לִישׁוּעָה בְּקָרוֹב לְמַעַן שְׁמוֹ יִתְבָּרֵךְ.

segments.en: And praised be G-d — just now it is somewhat quiet here — but still at every time I have fears when the anshei sh'lomaynu gather — and I do not know at all how to conduct myself. And thanks be to G-d — on the past *Shabbas* — four kosher guests were with me — and blessed be Hashem — we spoke words of truth and rejoiced a little. And all our words were on the matter of the *Midrash* I wrote to you — *"ein mechazkim ela limchuzakim"* — one strengthens only those who are already strong — and so forth. And due to the pressing — and also because I do not know by whom my letter will be sent since I am sending it to Breslov — it is therefore impossible to extend.

The words of your father who awaits salvation soon — for the sake of His name Yisborach. Overview: Sunday, Parshas Korach — Nemirov. To Yitzchok and all his descendants. Received his letter on Tuesday Parshas Sh'lach — very great comfort — for his eyes were watching and yearning all this time to see his letter — and his hope was disappointed — for the letter was delayed until that Tuesday. Blessed be Hashem Who helped him until here — that he informed him of good news from the recovery of his children and that he received his letter. Blessed be Hashem Who helped him until here. Praised be G-d — somewhat quiet here just now — but still at every time he has fears when the anshei sh'lomaynu gather — and he does not know at all how to conduct himself. Thanks be to G-d — on the past Shabbas — four kosher guests were with him — and blessed be Hashem — they spoke words of truth and rejoiced a little. And all their words were on the matter of the Midrash he wrote to them — "ein mechazkim ela limchuzakim" and so forth. Due to the pressing and because he does not know by whom his letter will be sent — it is impossible to extend.
